_metadata.description: Stable derived shopping lists with Review and Shop modes, honest package and unknown states, Have this assertions, purchase confirmation, plan-change diffs, and an event-based stock ledger with batches.

requirements.title: The shopping list is derived and transparent
requirements.description: The scenario shall derive the shopping list from an explicitly identified plan or date range and the current inventory policy, keep each row's identity stable across recalculation through canonical requirement grouping, group rows by store section or custom aisle order with search, and show total need, usable stock considered, missing amount, package plan, and price coverage while keeping product and preparation distinctions such as canned versus fresh or dry versus cooked.

validation.notes: Planned: equivalent units combine only through valid mappings and unresolved quantities stay visibly unresolved; a row can show known needed mass with an unknown package count (ACT-023).

requirements.title: Package counts and overrides are honest
requirements.description: The scenario shall round package counts upward where appropriate, retain a user purchase override with a mismatch badge when plan need later changes, keep manual grocery items distinct from plan-derived requirements, and treat Already have as an editable stock assertion stronger than a shopping checkmark.

validation.notes: Planned: replanning cannot delete a manual item, and an override retains its mismatch badge after the derived need changes (ACT-023).

requirements.title: Stock is an idempotent event ledger
requirements.description: The scenario shall represent stock through events for purchase, assertion, correction, preparation consumption, batch creation, portion consumption, waste, transfer, and reversal, each with an idempotency key, and the current projection shall be recomputable and testable.

validation.notes: Planned: retrying a committed stock operation does not change event counts or projections, and the projection recomputes from the ledger (ACT-024).

requirements.title: Future reservations never consume on-hand stock
requirements.description: While a plan reserves an ingredient for future cooking, the scenario shall not subtract it from on-hand stock, and the planner rebuilding a plan shall exclude its own replaced reservations so repeated replans do not appear to run out of stock.

validation.notes: Planned: FIX-03 confirmation consumes raw ingredients once, later portions reduce the prepared batch only, and a cancel releases a reservation without erasing prepared food (ACT-048, ACT-049).

requirements.title: Picked up, Have this, purchased, and consumed are distinct
requirements.description: Checking a shopping row shall mean only picked up; Have this shall create or update a stock assertion with an exact or qualitative basis without checking the row; Confirm purchases shall preview actual amounts and optional prices and create purchase and inventory events atomically and exactly once with partial fulfillment keeping the remaining need visible; and no shopping action shall record intake.

validation.notes: Planned: checking a row creates no payment, stock, or intake event (AT-031); Have some rice subtracts no invented grams (AT-036).
Planned: confirming a partial purchase twice through a retry applies the actual quantity once and leaves the remainder visible (AT-032, ACT-025).

requirements.title: Review and Shop modes exist on every device
requirements.description: The Groceries destination shall offer Review and Shop modes on both desktop and phone and remember the user's choice, where Review emphasizes pantry checks, overrides, substitutions, contributing meals, and uncertain quantities, and Shop emphasizes large checkboxes and quantities with checked rows moving into Picked up with immediate Undo and no focus loss.

validation.notes: Planned: checking a row in Shop moves it to Picked up, Undo restores it, and keyboard focus stays on the next row (R14.1).
Planned: the chosen mode persists across reload on both a desktop and a phone viewport (R14.1).

requirements.title: Plan changes produce a reviewable shopping diff
requirements.description: While a list is being shopped, a plan change shall produce a reviewable diff of Added, Changed, and No longer needed rows that preserves manual items, quantity overrides, and checked or purchased quantities, marks only the additional amount of an increased requirement for review, and applies with revision checks.

validation.notes: Planned: removing Tuesday curry keeps a manual item and the tofu purchase; adding 150 g more rice keeps the fulfilled amount and flags the new shortage (AT-033, AT-034, R14.3).

requirements.title: Substitutions are previewed and keep exclusions
requirements.description: When a user substitutes an ingredient, product, or method from a shopping row, the scenario shall preview the affected recipes, quantities, nutrition, rules, and costs, never let a cheaper alternative bypass an exclusion, and create future-use revisions or overrides instead of silently rewriting immutable recipes.

validation.notes: Planned: a cheaper substitute containing an excluded ingredient is not offered as compliant, and applying a substitution leaves the source recipe revision unchanged (R14.4).
